description: Basalt Sentinel, defensive elite enemy for a retro sci-fi pixel art JRPG card battler. Wide squat four-legged stone construct, massive overlapping basalt armor plates, small pale crystal core, fortress-like silhouette, charcoal and slate material, low top-down three-quarter view, upper-left lighting, chunky readable pixel clusters, selective outline, limited material shading, transparent background, no tiny noisy details.
